method: Original 25 rock envelopes vs closed authored LOD geometry (plus collar/crown). Three visitor-height origins, full 360 degrees in 3 degree increments. Every previously blocked horizontal visitor-height ray must still hit authored geology at every LOD. Upward rays are also recorded: individual skyline rays can change with inward crest chips, while macro corners/hulls are separately locked. This is sampled coverage, not universal seam/z-fighting proof.
